critical_code_review_comments: auth.tsx's lang fallback chain (user?.ui_language || localLanguage || countryToLang(localCountry)) means a brand-new user who selects a non-Polish country (e.g. USA/UK/Australia/Germany/Netherlands) WITHOUT explicitly tapping a language chip will get the quiz and rest of the app in that country's native language, not Polish, even though the country-select screen visually shows 'Polski' highlighted by default before any country is tapped. This is working as designed (confirmed against iteration_49's documented behavior) but could be a source of confusion/future bug reports since the visual default (Polski chip highlighted) doesn't match the actual effective language once a non-Polish country is chosen without an explicit language tap. Worth a product decision on whether this implicit coupling should remain or whether ui_language should always default to the visually-highlighted language (Polish) unless explicitly changed, truly independent of country as the feature's name implies.

Confirmed server.py's AI-generation language-splitting pipeline (career titles in country-native language, descriptions in ui_language) is intact after the quiz-steps.ts localization change - real AI output matched spec exactly for DE country / en language.
